items.title_en: Russia says at least seven killed in largest Ukrainian attack of 2026
items.summary_en: Russia reported at least seven people killed in what officials called Ukraine's largest-scale attack of 2026, involving 822 drones, 600 of them targeting Moscow. Russian strikes on Ukraine killed at least seven people and injured more than 39 overnight, with air-raid sirens sounding four times in Kyiv. President Zelensky said Russia launched more than 1,550 attack drones, nearly 1,560 guided aerial bombs and 62 missiles at 13 regions this week.
items.title_zh: 俄羅斯稱烏克蘭發動 2026 年最大規模攻擊，至少 7 人喪生
items.summary_zh: 俄羅斯通報至少 7 人喪生於官方所稱烏克蘭 2026 年最大規模攻擊，共出動 822 架無人機，其中 600 架瞄準莫斯科。俄軍夜間空襲烏克蘭也造成至少 7 死、逾 39 傷，基輔一夜之間四度響起防空警報。澤倫斯基總統表示，俄羅斯本週對 13 個地區發射逾 1,550 架攻擊無人機、近 1,560 枚導引炸彈與 62 枚飛彈。

items.title_en: Reddit to join the S&P 500 on Tuesday, replacing AvalonBay Communities
items.summary_en: Reddit will join the S&P 500 on Tuesday, replacing AvalonBay Communities and becoming only the second pureplay social media company in the benchmark index after Meta. The stock surged nearly 14% after the announcement, as index funds tracking the S&P 500 must buy shares once a company is included. The inclusion comes weeks after Reddit posted its highest-ever quarterly revenue.
items.title_zh: Reddit 將於週二納入 S&P 500 指數，取代 AvalonBay Communities
items.summary_zh: Reddit 將於週二正式納入 S&P 500 指數，取代 AvalonBay Communities，成為繼 Meta 之後指數中第二家純社群媒體公司。消息公布後股價大漲近 14%，因為追蹤 S&P 500 的指數基金在成分股納入後必須買進其股票。此次納入距 Reddit 繳出史上最高單季營收僅數週。

items.title_en: BWF World Championships open in New Delhi with Taiwan's Chou Tien-chen and Lin Chun-yi seeded
items.summary_en: The 30th edition of the BWF World Championships begins Monday at the Indira Gandhi Arena in New Delhi, with India hosting the tournament for the first time since 2009. A total of 64 players in each singles draw and 48 pairs in each doubles event will compete over seven days. Taiwan's Chou Tien-chen and Lin Chun-yi are seeded sixth and 12th in men's singles, while defending champion Shi Yuqi faces home hope Ayush Shetty in a blockbuster first round.
items.title_zh: BWF 世界羽球錦標賽新德里開打，台灣周天成、林俊易列種子
items.summary_zh: 第 30 屆 BWF 世界羽球錦標賽週一於新德里英迪拉·甘地體育館揭幕，這是印度自 2009 年以來首度主辦。單打各 64 名選手、三項雙打各 48 對組合將展開為期七天的爭奪。台灣周天成與林俊易分列男單第 6 與第 12 種子，衛冕冠軍石宇奇首輪則將對決地主新星謝提。
